note.description: One line on what this change is for. Shown to the person waiting.

ops.description: Applied in order. Either they all pass validation or none are kept. Each upsert adds one thing or replaces the one that already has its key, stated in full — anything omitted is cleared — and touches nothing else. Send several in one call.

oneOf.title: upsert_entity
oneOf.description: One entity, with its fields. Send one per entity in a single call to establish a whole domain at once.

oneOf.title: upsert_field
oneOf.description: One field on an existing entity, when the entity itself is otherwise unchanged.

oneOf.title: remove
oneOf.description: Remove an entity, or a field when `field` is given.

field.description: Field key. Omit to remove the entity itself.

label.description: Singular, as a person would say it.

labelPlural.description: Plural, if it is not just label + s.

description.description: What one record of this represents.

icon.description: Material Design Icons name, without the mdi- prefix.

displayField.description: The field that names a record in pickers and links.

kind.description: collection (default): people browse these. config: a lookup list other entities point at, filed under Configuration. settings: a single record of app-wide settings.

ownedBy.description: Set when records only exist inside a parent — line items, comments, answers. They get no navigation of their own and appear inside the parent instead. Give this entity a reference field pointing at the parent; which one that is gets worked out for you.

series.description: Set when rows form an ordered run and a figure carries from one to the next — a running balance, a closing stock level. Required before any field can use prev().

partition.description: Reference field; rows sharing it form one run.

order.description: Numeric or date field giving the order within the run.

unique.description: Field combinations no two records may share. One booking per (room, slot).

required.description: A record cannot be saved without it.

unique.description: No two records may share this value.

indexed.description: Set on fields that are filtered or sorted often.

help.description: A sentence under the input, when the label is not enough.

group.description: Section heading to file this under on the record.

default.description: Value a new record starts with.

unit.description: Suffix shown after the number — kg, hours, %. Never on money.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for a money field.

role.description: status: the one governed state field, which drives boards and steppers. start/due: the dates a calendar or timeline reads. order: manual drag ordering.

target.description: For type=reference: the entity key this points at. With targetApp='platform' it must be one of: department, group, person. There is no 'user' — a human being is 'person'. A company is 'organization'.

targetApp.description: Into another app: 'platform' for the shared department/group/person records, or a core app — core_people, core_organizations, core_calendar. Never re-declare a core app. Omit within this app.

onDelete.description: What happens to this record when the referenced one is deleted.

options.description: For select/multiselect: the choices. Prefer a closed set over free text.

expr.description: Worked out from this record's own fields, recalculated on every write: `gross_salary * (1 + employer_cost_rate / 100)`. Arithmetic, comparisons, and/or/not, pow(). On a series entity, `prev(field, seed)` reads the row before this one — that is how a running balance is expressed. A field with expr is never typed in.

aggregate.description: Worked out from OTHER records. An invoice's total, a period's payroll cost, a project's open task count.

of.description: The entity whose records are added up.

field.description: The numeric field on it. Omit only for count.

over.description: How those records relate to this one. "mine" for records that point directly at this record — an invoice totalling its own lines. Otherwise name a reference field on THIS entity, meaning records that point at the same thing it does: a period sums the hiring lines of its own scenario, where neither owns the other and they share a parent. Defaults to "mine".

during.description: Count a record only while it is in range. Use exactly one direction. Anything named my* is a field on THIS record; everything else is on the records being added up. Bounds may be dates or numbers as long as both sides agree. An omitted end is open.

covering.description: The record spans a RANGE and must cover a point on mine — a hire being paid in this month.

to.description: End of it. Omit for open-ended.

myPoint.description: The date or number on THIS record it must cover.

inside.description: The record has ONE date and must fall inside a range on mine — a payment landing in the month it is made.

at.description: The record's own date or number.

myTo.description: End of it. Omit for open-ended.

where.description: Narrow which records count — only the ones whose basis is 'revenue'.
